channel.title: Los Angeles Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles Times (latimes.com)

item.title: U.S. is in the dark on Mojtaba Khamenei's views on the bomb
item.description: Khamenei's deep alliance with the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps has raised concern that Iran's new leader will depart from his father's long-standing position against building a bomb.

item.title: Celebrity chef René Redzepi resigns from Noma amid past abuse allegations
item.description: On the day Noma launched its Los Angeles residency, the chef announced he would leave the restaurant's operations.

item.title: Runners sympathize with L.A. Marathon runner-up led off course, but say fans are vital
item.description: A fan briefly led Michael Kimani Kamau off course late in the closest L.A. Marathon in history, contributing to his loss. No one has appealed the race result.

item.title: Advocates concerned city has not reviewed LA28 plan for homelessness, human trafficking
item.description: No date for the report's release has been set, leaving human rights advocates fearing the issues will not get the attention and funding they deserve.

item.title: California sues over Trump demand for college race, test score and GPA admissions data
item.description: California and a coalition of 16 state Democratic attorneys general filed a lawsuit challenging a Trump administration policy that requires higher education campuses to collect data showing they aren't considering race in admissions.

item.title: Man convicted in shooting that had potential to cause LAPD helicopter crash
item.description: Douglass Byers was convicted of firing a rifle shot that pierced the tail of an LAPD helicopter in South L.A. last year. Prosecutors say the round could have caused a catastrophic helicopter crash.

item.title: Iconic Malibu restaurant poised to reopen 14 months after Palisades fire
item.description: Duke's Malibu, an landmark coastal restaurant on Pacific Coast Highway, will reopen after extensive mudslide damage following the Palisades fire.

item.title: California's richest real estate: Why these cities top our list without Silicon Valley gold
item.description: In 2001, seven of the 10 richest ZIP Codes in the state were in Northern California. Now, seven of the 10 are located in Southern California. Here's what has drawn the wealthy to enclaves like Newport Beach.

item.title: Why hundreds of people in L.A. are strapping cameras on their bodies to do chores
item.description: AI and robotics companies need data on movements in the physical world. Some are paying gig workers to record themselves cooking dinner and doing laundry.

item.title: U.S. refueling plane crashes over Iraq, military says
item.description: An Air Force KC-135 refueling plane in the military campaign against Iran crashed 'in friendly airspace' over Iraq, U.S. Central Command said.
